items.title_zh: SyNexus 非侵入式自适应脑机接口项目
items.title_en: SyNexus Non-invasive Adaptive Brain-Computer Interface Project
bullets_zh: GitHub项目，曾在2026年创新生物医学设备竞赛与展示会上展出。
描述一种非侵入式自适应脑机接口，采集初级运动皮层信号用于神经病理和神经创伤应用。
记录硬件软件架构、实验流程和未来工作。
bullets_en: GitHub project presented at the Innovating Biomedical Devices Competition and Showcase 2026.
Describes a non-invasive adaptive BCI acquiring primary motor cortex signals for neuropathology and neurotrauma applications.
Documents hardware/software architecture, the experimental pipeline, and future work.
items.brief: GitHub上的非侵入式BCI项目，适合了解竞赛级软硬件方案。
items.brief_en: GitHub project for a non-invasive adaptive BCI presented at a biomedical device competition.
items.raw_excerpt: Presented at the Innovating Biomedical Devices Competition and Showcase 2026. A Non-invasive and Adaptive Brain-Computer Interface acquiring signals from the primary motor cortex to address neuropathologies and neurotrauma. Covers hardware/software architecture, the experimental pipeline, and future developments in componentry and connectivity.

items.title_zh: 用于智能家居控制的脑机接口项目
items.title_en: EEG Brain-Computer Interface for Smart Home Control
bullets_zh: GitHub项目实现用于免提智能家居控制的实时EEG脑机接口。
使用CNN-BiLSTM分类眨眼和注意力信号，并加入模糊逻辑决策层。
驱动ESP32执行器，展示一个易用的消费级非侵入式BCI应用。
bullets_en: GitHub project implementing real-time EEG BCI for hands-free smart-home control.
Uses CNN-BiLSTM classification of blink and attention signals with a fuzzy-logic decision layer.
Drives ESP32 actuators, demonstrating an accessible consumer-style non-invasive BCI application.
items.brief: GitHub上的EEG智能家居控制项目，展示实时非侵入式BCI应用。
items.brief_en: GitHub EEG project for hands-free smart-home control using blink/attention classification and ESP32 actuators.
items.raw_excerpt: Real-time EEG brain-computer interface for hands-free smart-home control — CNN-BiLSTM blink and attention classification with a fuzzy-logic decision layer, driving ESP32 actuators

bullets_zh: 实现结合P300与SSVEP范式的非侵入式脑电拼写器。
提供离线分类器训练和基于浏览器的用户校准。
通过Lab Streaming Layer（LSL）输出实时操作系统按键。
bullets_en: Implements a non-invasive EEG speller combining P300 and SSVEP paradigms.
Provides offline classifier training plus browser-based user calibration.
Outputs real-time OS keypresses through Lab Streaming Layer (LSL).
items.brief: 开源P300/SSVEP脑电拼写器，含离线训练、浏览器校准与LSL实时输出。
items.brief_en: Open-source P300 and SSVEP EEG speller with offline training, browser calibration, and LSL real-time output.
items.raw_excerpt: P300 + SSVEP brain-computer interface speller — offline classifier training, browser-based calibration, real-time OS keypress output via LSL.

items.title_zh: GitHub：Gwennispontaneous793/EEG_Deformer 用于BCI解码的PyTorch EEG Deformer
bullets_zh: 提供用于脑电解码的密集卷积Transformer的PyTorch实现。
面向使用非侵入式脑电信号的脑机接口应用。
可作为高级深度学习基线或研究代码库。
bullets_en: Provides a PyTorch implementation of a dense convolutional transformer for EEG decoding.
Targets brain-computer interface applications with non-invasive EEG signals.
Useful as an advanced deep-learning baseline or research codebase.
items.brief: 开源PyTorch实现，用密集卷积Transformer解码脑电信号。
items.brief_en: Open-source PyTorch implementation using a dense convolutional transformer to decode EEG signals.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of a dense convolutional transformer for brain-computer interface applications.

items.title_zh: GitHub：aliazhardewali-pixel/eeg-bci EEG运动速度控制脑机接口项目（MEDICO 2026）
bullets_zh: 展示一种基于EEG的脑机接口，用于控制运动速度。
托管由杜胡克大学生物医学工程学生为埃尔比勒的MEDICO 2026准备的项目网站。
可作为入门到中级教育型BCI实现参考。
bullets_en: Presents an EEG-based brain-computer interface for controlling motor speed.
Hosts the project site for MEDICO 2026 in Erbil by University of Duhok biomedical engineering students.
Useful as a beginner-to-intermediate educational BCI implementation.
items.brief: 展示基于EEG的运动速度控制BCI，作为MEDICO 2026学生项目。
items.brief_en: Showcases an EEG-based motor speed control BCI as a student project for MEDICO 2026.
items.raw_excerpt: EEG-Based Motor Speed Control System Using a Brain-Computer Interface - project site for MEDICO 2026, Erbil. Biomedical Engineering, University of Duhok.

items.title_zh: GitHub：Julian-Reguera/TFG-BCI 基于EEG运动想象的电子游戏控制脑机接口项目（含个人数据集）
bullets_zh: 构建基于EEG的脑机接口，利用运动想象控制电子游戏。
包含为该项目采集的个性化EEG数据集。
可作为实用非侵入式BCI实现和小型自定义基准参考。
bullets_en: Builds an EEG-based BCI that controls video games using motor imagery.
Includes a personalized EEG dataset collected for the project.
Relevant as a practical non-invasive BCI implementation and small custom benchmark.
items.brief: 开源EEG运动想象BCI，用于控制电子游戏并附个性化数据集。
items.brief_en: Open-source EEG motor-imagination BCI for video-game control with a personalized dataset.
items.raw_excerpt: Sistema BCI para el control de videojuegos mediante señales EEG según el paradigma de imaginación motora, incluyendo un dataset eprsonalizado de EEG.
